'''Noriaki Kanze''' (Japanese: '''観世智顕''' ''Kanze Noriaki'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.  

==Biography==
Kanze was born sometime on October 15. He started working on the {{pkmn|animated series}} with {{aniseries|JN}}, voicing a number of characters, most notably [[Ren]], one of [[Professor Cerise]]'s assistants; and some of [[List of Goh's Pokémon|Goh's Pokémon]]. Kanze is currently affiliated with {{wp|Ken Production}}.
